text: # Account Lockout Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee cannot sign in to their corporate account because the account has been locked after multiple unsuccessful login attempts. ## Common Symptoms - The login page displays an account locked message. - The employee cannot access corporate applications. - Login attempts fail even when the correct password is entered. - The account is temporarily blocked after repeated failed attempts. ## Possible Causes - Multiple incorrect password attempts. - An outdated password saved on another device. - Background applications repeatedly attempting authentication. - Suspicious or unusual login activity. - Organization-defined account security restrictions. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Stop repeated login attempts to avoid extending the lockout. 2. Verify that you are using the correct corporate username. 3. Check whether your password was recently changed. 4. If your organization provides an approved self-service account unlock portal, follow its identity verification process. 5. Check whether other devices or applications are using an outdated saved password. 6. If the account remains locked, contact the authorized IT support team. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if:

If the account remains locked, contact the authorized IT support team. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if: - The account remains locked after following the approved unlock process. - The employee cannot access the self-service portal. - The account repeatedly becomes locked. - The employee suspects unauthorized login attempts. - Multiple employees experience the same account lockout issue. ## Security Precautions - Never share your password or MFA verification codes. - Never ask another person to unlock your account using their credentials. - Report suspicious login notifications to the authorized IT security team. - Use only organization-approved account recovery procedures. ## Expected Resolution The employee regains access after completing the organization's approved identity verification and account unlock process. If the issue persists, IT support must investigate further. ## Support Category Account Access ## Keywords account locked, account lockout, unable to login, login blocked, too many failed attempts, unlock account, corporate account access, authentication failure

# DNS Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee cannot access internal or external websites because of DNS resolution failures. ## Common Symptoms - Website cannot be reached. - DNS server not responding error. - Internal applications fail to load. - Unable to resolve domain names. - Internet works using an IP address but not a domain name. ## Possible Causes - Incorrect DNS server configuration. - DNS cache issues. - Network connectivity problems. - VPN DNS configuration conflicts. - Temporary DNS server outage. - Incorrect network adapter settings. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Verify that your internet or corporate network connection is working. 2. Disconnect and reconnect to the network. 3. Restart your computer and try accessing the website again. 4. Check whether the issue affects multiple websites or only one. 5. If the problem occurs while using VPN, reconnect to the approved corporate VPN. 6. Contact IT support to check DNS server configuration and domain resolution. 7. Ask IT support to investigate DNS server availability if the issue affects multiple employees. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if: -

DNS server configuration and domain resolution. 7. Ask IT support to investigate DNS server availability if the issue affects multiple employees. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if: - DNS server errors continue. - Multiple employees cannot access internal applications. - Corporate websites fail to resolve. - DNS problems continue after reconnecting to the network. ## Security Precautions - Do not change corporate DNS settings without IT approval. - Use only organization-approved network configurations. - Report suspicious redirects or unexpected websites. ## Expected Resolution DNS resolution works correctly, allowing employees to access authorized internal and external websites. ## Support Category Network Connectivity ## Keywords DNS troubleshooting, DNS server not responding, domain resolution failure, website not reachable, DNS cache, corporate DNS, VPN DNS issue

# Laptop Startup Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee's laptop does not start, fails to boot, or gets stuck during startup. ## Common Symptoms - Laptop does not power on. - Power button works but screen remains black. - Laptop gets stuck on the startup logo. - Operating system fails to load. - Laptop repeatedly restarts. - Blue screen or boot error appears. ## Possible Causes - Battery completely discharged. - Faulty charger or power adapter. - Hardware failure. - Operating system corruption. - Failed system update. - External device causing startup problems. - Insufficient power supply. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Check whether the laptop charger is properly connected. 2. Verify that the power outlet and adapter are working. 3. Connect the charger and allow the battery to charge for some time. 4. Disconnect external USB devices and peripherals. 5. Hold the power button to perform a normal forced shutdown, then try restarting. 6. Check whether the laptop displays any error messages. 7. # MFA Authentication Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee cannot complete Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) while signing in to corporate applications. ## Common Symptoms - MFA verification code is rejected. - Authentication notification does not appear on the registered device. - MFA application displays an error. - Employee cannot approve the login request. - Authentication repeatedly fails. ## Possible Causes - Incorrect or expired verification code. - Incorrect device time settings. - Internet connectivity problems. - Outdated authentication application. - Employee changed or lost their registered phone. - Temporary identity provider issues. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Confirm that you are using the correct registered authentication device. 2. Check that your device has a stable internet connection. 3. Verify that the device date and time are set automatically. 4. Request a fresh verification code if the previous code has expired. 5. If using an authenticator application, check whether it requires an update. 6. If an approval notification does not appear, open the organization's approved authentication application and check for pending requests. 7. # Outlook Email Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee experiences problems with Microsoft Outlook, including email synchronization failures, sending or receiving emails, or application performance issues. ## Common Symptoms - Outlook is not synchronizing emails. - Unable to send or receive emails. - Emails remain stuck in the Outbox. - Outlook displays disconnected status. - New emails are not appearing. - Outlook application freezes or crashes. ## Possible Causes - Internet connectivity problems. - Outlook is offline. - Incorrect account configuration. - Mailbox storage limit reached. - Corrupted Outlook profile. - Outdated Outlook application. - Temporary mail server issues. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Verify that your internet connection is working. 2. Check whether Outlook displays Work Offline mode. 3. If Work Offline is enabled, disable it. 4. Restart the Outlook application. 5. Check whether emails are stuck in the Outbox. 6. Verify that your mailbox has available storage space. 7. Check whether Outlook requires an update. 8. Try accessing corporate email through the organization's approved webmail portal. 9. If synchronization problems continue, contact authorized IT support. ## When to Escalate

Check whether Outlook requires an update. 8. Try accessing corporate email through the organization's approved webmail portal. 9. If synchronization problems continue, contact authorized IT support. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if: - Emails cannot be sent or received. - Outlook repeatedly disconnects. - Mailbox synchronization continues to fail. - Multiple employees experience email issues. - Outlook crashes repeatedly. ## Security Precautions - Never share corporate email passwords. - Do not open suspicious email attachments. - Report phishing emails through approved company procedures. - Use only organization-approved email applications. ## Expected Resolution Outlook synchronizes successfully, and the employee can send and receive corporate emails. ## Support Category Email Support ## Keywords Outlook not syncing, email synchronization failure, unable to send email, unable to receive email, Outlook disconnected, emails stuck in Outbox, mailbox full, Outlook troubleshooting

# Slow Laptop Performance Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee experiences slow laptop performance, delayed application responses, or frequent system freezing while performing daily work. ## Common Symptoms - Laptop takes a long time to start. - Applications open slowly. - System freezes or becomes unresponsive. - High CPU or memory usage. - Browser tabs respond slowly. - Laptop becomes slow when multiple applications are running. ## Possible Causes - Too many applications running simultaneously. - Insufficient RAM. - High CPU or disk usage. - Low available storage space. - Too many startup applications. - Outdated operating system or drivers. - Background updates or antivirus scans. - Malware or suspicious applications. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Restart the laptop and check whether performance improves. 2. Close unnecessary applications and browser tabs. 3. Open Task Manager and check CPU, memory, and disk usage. 4. Identify applications consuming excessive system resources. 5. Close unnecessary startup applications using approved system settings. 6. Check whether sufficient storage space is available. 7. # Microsoft Teams Audio and Video Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee experiences audio, video, or meeting connectivity issues while using Microsoft Teams. ## Common Symptoms - Microphone is not working. - Other participants cannot hear the employee. - Camera is not detected. - Video appears blurry or freezes. - No sound during meetings. - Teams calls disconnect unexpectedly. - Unable to join or connect to meetings. ## Possible Causes - Incorrect microphone or speaker selection. - Camera or microphone permissions are disabled. - Another application is using the camera or microphone. - Unstable internet connection. - Outdated Teams application. - Outdated audio or camera drivers. - Incorrect device settings. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Verify that your internet connection is stable. 2. Restart the Microsoft Teams application. 3. Open Teams device settings and select the correct microphone, speaker, and camera. 4. Check that microphone and camera permissions are enabled. 5. Close other applications that may be using the microphone or camera. 6. # VPN Connectivity Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee cannot connect to the organization's corporate VPN or experiences frequent VPN disconnections. ## Common Symptoms - VPN connection fails. - VPN disconnects frequently. - Unable to access internal company resources. - VPN authentication fails. - VPN connection becomes very slow. ## Possible Causes - Unstable internet connection. - Incorrect VPN credentials. - Expired password. - Outdated VPN client. - Incorrect VPN configuration. - Temporary VPN server outage. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Verify that your internet connection is working. 2. Confirm that you are using the correct corporate username and password. 3. Check whether your corporate password has expired. 4. # Wi-Fi Connectivity Troubleshooting ## Problem Description An employee cannot connect to the corporate Wi-Fi network or experiences unstable wireless connectivity. ## Common Symptoms - Unable to connect to corporate Wi-Fi. - Connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access. - Wi-Fi disconnects frequently. - Incorrect Wi-Fi password error. - Slow network performance. - Unable to access internal company applications. ## Possible Causes - Incorrect Wi-Fi credentials. - Weak wireless signal. - Router or access point issues. - Incorrect IP configuration. - DNS resolution problems. - Outdated wireless network drivers. - Temporary network outage. ## Troubleshooting Steps 1. Confirm that Wi-Fi is enabled on your device. 2. Verify that you are connecting to the correct corporate Wi-Fi network. 3. Re-enter your approved Wi-Fi credentials. 4. Move closer to the wireless access point. 5. Disconnect from Wi-Fi and reconnect. 6. Restart your computer and try again. 7. Check whether other employees are experiencing the same issue. 8. If connected but unable to access resources, contact IT support for network and DNS checks. ## When to Escalate Contact IT support if: - Corporate Wi-Fi remains unavailable. - Multiple employees experience connectivity problems. - Wi-Fi disconnects repeatedly. - Internal applications remain inaccessible. ## Security Precautions - Connect only to authorized corporate Wi-Fi networks. - Never share corporate network credentials. - Avoid unknown or suspicious wireless networks. ## Expected Resolution The employee successfully connects to corporate Wi-Fi and accesses authorized network resources. ## Support Category Network Connectivity ## Keywords Wi-Fi not connecting, corporate Wi-Fi, wireless network, no internet access, frequent disconnection, DNS issue, network connectivity
